program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        end = len(row)\n        i = end - 1\n        while i >= 0 and row[i] == bg:\n            i -= 1\n        if i < 0 or i == end - 1:\n            continue\n        color = row[i]\n        j = i\n        while j >= 0 and row[j] == color:\n            j -= 1\n        if i - j >= 3:\n            for k in range(i + 1, end):\n                row[k] = 1\n    return out\n'''
